census_provenance.rule_version: hit_rules.md R19 (2026-09-24): hit = market x pinned window with a depeg window and I1 in [window start - 30 d, window end]; R4 filter 0.97; 7-day family merge

market_mapping: morpho:<cid>:<id> -> id; euler:<cid>:<lending>:<collateral> -> lending vault; silo:<cid>:<silo config> -> the silo of that config whose paired silo holds the family token
moolah_rules: I1: oracle peek(collateral)/peek(loan) over the DefiLlama close ratio >= 1.08 on two consecutive day ends; I2: utilization >= 99% for >= 72 h; I3: borrow APR >= 50% of the market's rate cap (30% APR IRM maximum where none is set); depeg: a daily close <= 0.97 of the family peg (wrappers through their unwrap terminal); all within [window start - 30 d, window end] (R19); onset = max(window start, first depeg close); I4 not scanned (as in the census)
what: depeg-loss hits on the 14 pairs: the census table imported hit by hit (Morpho, Euler, Silo) and the Moolah scan by the same rules
